review.summary: The PR cleanly refactors Sarvam STT/TTS to use config dataclasses for model variants, but several inconsistencies between docs, defaults, and runtime behavior need attention. Most critical: TTS v3-beta default speaker is documented as "aditya" but coded as "shubh"; warning conditions like `params.pitch != 0.0` fire spuriously when user passes None; and the STT `_connect()` silently dropped `input_audio_codec` which may break v2.5 servers. There are also a docstring example syntax error and a silent override of `enable_preprocessing` on v3.

issues.description: TTS v3-beta default speaker mismatch: docs/PR description say 'aditya' but code sets 'shubh'
issues.detail: In TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS['bulbul:v3-beta'], default_speaker='shubh', but the module docstring, class docstring, SarvamTTSModel enum docstring, and PR description all state the default is 'aditya'. Users relying on the documented default will get a different voice than expected. Pick one and align all sources.

issues.description: Warning conditions like `params.pitch != 0.0` produce spurious warnings when user passes None
issues.detail: Fields are Optional[float] with defaults. If a user explicitly passes `pitch=None`, `loudness=None`, or `temperature=None`, the conditions `params.pitch != 0.0`, `params.loudness != 1.0`, and `params.temperature != 0.6` are True, so a misleading 'parameter is ignored' warning is logged. Compare against the default with an explicit not-None guard.

issues.description: STT _connect() dropped `input_audio_codec` from connect_kwargs — possible regression for v2.5
issues.detail: Previously `connect_kwargs` included `'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec`. The new diff removes this entirely from the kwargs dict. If the Sarvam SDK or saarika/saaras v2.5 streaming endpoints require this field, existing v2.5 users will see broken connections. Confirm the SDK no longer needs it or re-add it for models that do.

issues.description: v3-beta silently overrides user-specified `enable_preprocessing=False` with no warning
issues.detail: When `preprocessing_always_enabled=True`, the settings dict force-sets True regardless of the user-supplied value. Other ignored parameters (pitch, loudness, temperature) log a warning when the user provided a non-default; preprocessing should do the same so users learn their explicit `False` was overridden.

issues.description: Docstring example has a syntax error: `model="bulbul:v3,` (missing closing quote)
issues.detail: The existing example for v3 was updated to `model="bulbul:v3-beta"`, but a similar broken example with `model="bulbul:v3,` (no closing quote, trailing comma) still appears in the example block of SarvamHttpTTSService. If users copy/paste this snippet, it won't parse. Clean up to a single, valid example.

issues.description: `get_speakers_for_model` silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: Returning v2 speakers for an unknown model masks typos and future model additions. Callers can use the returned list to validate input and will accept v2 names for an unrecognized model. Either raise ValueError or return an empty list so the caller fails fast; align with the strict validation done in `__init__`.
